item.text: [{"task_id":"d364b489","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    anchor = int(round(params['anchor'][0]))","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    for position in np.argwhere(grid == anchor):","        row, col = position","        for entry in params['stencil']:","            dr = int(round(entry[0]))","            dc = int(round(entry[1]))","            colour = int(round(entry[2]))","            rr = row + dr","            cc = col + dc","            if 0 <= rr < height and 0 <= cc < width:","                out[rr, cc] = colour","    return out"],"shapes":{"anchor":[1],"stencil":[4,3]},"params":{"anchor":[1],"stencil":[[-1,0,2],[1,0,8],[0,-1,7],[0,1,6]]},"rationale":"Each blue cell receives red above, azure below, orange left, and magenta right.
